name: Ally Rescue
public_description: ALLY has gone missing. They were last seen on the road near LOCATION. REWARD is offered for their safe return.
gm_notes: ALLY was captured by ENEMY and is being held in their camp.

flow.details: You must figure out what happened and locate enemy camp.
You must overcome the enemy to rescue the ally. Depending on the outcome, you may receive REWARD as loot.
You must convince the ally to join you.

name: Beast Trouble
public_description: A BEAST has been causing trouble at LOCATION. REWARD is promised to anyone who can deal with it.
gm_notes: ENEMY is currently cornered by the beast. Decide on the circumstance (example, pet turned on master, trapper got cornered, etc.).

flow.details: You can assess the scene and figure out what's going on.
You must overcome the beast.
You can overcome the enemy. If successful, you receive REWARD.

name: Ally Quest
public_description: ALLY is seeking brave souls to recover a lost treasure from BEAST's lair. REWARD is offered for its return.
gm_notes: Ally won't reveal LOCATION until they decide you're the one for the job. There is more treasure than what they seek.

flow.details: You must convince ALLY that you're the one for the job.
You must overcome BEAST to reclaim the treasure and bring it back to ALLY.
You can find additional REWARD as you explore the area.

name: Beast Trouble
public_description: A BEAST has been causing trouble at LOCATION. REWARD is promised to anyone who can deal with it.
gm_notes: Depending on how you deal with the beast there may be no reward. If befriended the beast may lead them to an alternate reward.

flow.details: You must follow the tracks to the beast's lair.
Players must overcome the beast and secure proof that it's has been dealt with to claim the reward.

name: Captured Beast
public_description: My BEAST has gone missing. REWARD for its safe return. Last seen near LOCATION.
gm_notes: Beast was captured by ENEMY and is being held in a cage.

flow.details: You must overcome the captors to gain access to the cage. Depending on outcome you may receive REWARD as loot.
You must figure out how to open the cage.
You must earn the beast's trust to return it safely to its master.

name: Ally Rescue
public_description: ALLY has gone missing. They were last seen on the road near LOCATION. REWARD is offered for their safe return.
gm_notes: Ally is trapped in BEAST lair. Determine the circumstance (exploration gone wrong, captured by beast, etc.)

flow.details: You must figure out what happened and locate the lair.
Players must overcome or distract BEAST long enough to extract ALLY from the lair.
You must convince the ally to join you.

name: Battle
public_description: ENEMY and ENEMY forces are clashing at LOCATION, and the fighting threatens everyone nearby. REWARD is offered to anyone who can end the conflict.
gm_notes: Players can join with one to overcome the other, take on both, try to negotiate peace, or find another way to resolve the conflict.

flow.details: You can assess the situation and decide how to approach it.
You must deal with the first ENEMY force.
You must deal with the second ENEMY force.

name: Friendly Challenge
public_description: ALLY has issued a public challenge. REWARD to any one bold enough to meet them in friendly competition.
gm_notes: ALLY is testing the party's character, skill, or worthiness for future work. Winning cleanly leads to another opportunity. Skip convincing the ally if the quest calls for it.

flow.details: You must take part in ALLY's chosen contest and prove yourself through strength, wit, or discipline. Ally will choose the nature of the contest.

name: Recover Location
public_description: ENEMY has seized LOCATION and driven out ALLY. REWARD is offered to anyone who drives them out.
gm_notes: Enemy has set traps around the area.

flow.details: Players must deal with traps set by the enemy.
You must deal with traps set by the enemy.
You must overcome the ENEMY. Depending on how this is done you may receive REWARD as loot.
